uncertainty_note: Day-block bootstrap preserves candidate weighting for pooled Brier improvement and resamples contiguous five-session blocks. A day-plus-symbol two-way cluster sensitivity interval is also reported; 2025H2/2026H1 are exposed research periods, not independent holdouts.
interpretation_guardrails: Targets are vendor event-pool membership, not official price-limit states.
Predictions use D-1 fields, but historical publication-time/PIT availability is uncertified.
The prior ranking uses a heuristic event probability score and top-1/top-3 limits; it does not establish net expectancy or executable edge.
The 2026H1 period is exposed development data, not protected holdout.
